{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify the 6 rows with NaN revenue
df_nan_revenue = df[df['revenue_numeric'].isnull()]

# Check their status
df_nan_revenue['status'].unique()"}
